task.title: Rewrite architecture overview around artifact_state/deployment_stage split
task.summary_zh: 重寫 TARGET_ARCHITECTURE.md，將 artifact_state (draft/candidate/approved/retired) 與 deployment_stage (paper/canary/live/frozen) 明確分離，OpenClaw 定位為上游 OSS substrate。
acceptance: architecture overview no longer treats paper/live as artifact state
artifact_state vs deployment_stage ownership split is explicit
OpenClaw is described as upstream substrate, not the system name
